Name: Jehaleleel
Summary: Father of Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:16: Father of Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehaleleel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
